name: All Star Varsity Jackets
description: All Star Embroidery's WordPress/WooCommerce varsity jacket system with school browsing, multiple jacket styles per school, responsive image galleries, structured ZIP/CSV imports, live Gutenberg blocks, WooCommerce product tools, and organization-owned automatic updates.
changelog:
1.0.4

  • Moved the WordPress updater permanently to All-Star-Embroidery/varsity-jackets.
  • Clears pre-migration updater caches and refreshes the manifest namespace.
